entrypoints.note: package.json bin: {"eleventy": "cmd.cjs"} — the npm-installed 'eleventy' command. The user-facing entry.

note: Node SSG case: single user-facing entry, the package.json bin mapping to cmd.cjs (the existing package.json bin heuristic should hit it at high confidence). src/Core.js is the library core invoked by cmd.cjs, not a separate user entry. packages/ is a workspace (browser, build-awesome) — build/test tooling, not entry points.
